entities.name: Mahatma Gandhi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of the Indian independence movement (1869–1948) who pioneered nonviolent civil disobedience (satyagraha). His campaigns against British colonial rule inspired civil rights movements worldwide, from Martin Luther King Jr. to Nelson Mandela.
